aiSummary.summary: PHP maintainers have released security updates to address two critical vulnerabilities. These flaws could potentially allow unauthenticated remote code execution for affected installations.
aiSummary.whyItMatters: Unauthenticated remote code execution flaws present a severe security risk as they allow attackers to run arbitrary code on targeted servers without needing credentials.
aiSummary.action: Update PHP to versions 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, or 8.2.35 immediately.
